tabs.tab_title: How do I order and pay?
tabs.tab_content: Tap “Order on WhatsApp” on any coffee and its name is filled in for you. Once we confirm the order, we send a payment link for FPX online banking, Touch 'n Go eWallet or DuitNow QR.
We roast every Tuesday and Friday. Order by 11:59 pm the day before to make that batch. Bags ship the next day and arrive in 1–3 working days in West Malaysia, or 3–5 in East Malaysia.
West Malaysia: free over RM 80, otherwise RM 8. East Malaysia: free over RM 150, otherwise RM 15. Subscriptions always ship free.

tabs.tab_title: Can you grind it for me?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Tell us your brewer (pour-over, French press, moka pot, espresso machine or phin) and we'll grind to match. Ground coffee is best within two weeks.

tabs.tab_title: What if I don't like it?
tabs.tab_content: Within 14 days of delivery, if at least half the bag is left, we'll swap it for another coffee and cover shipping both ways.
